Island: a notification light for phones without one (inspired by AODLed). A ring, dot or glow drawn around the camera hole while a notification waits, with pulse, swirl or still motion, the colour of the app or one you pick, adjustable thickness and an option for silent notifications. It goes out when the notification is dismissed or the phone is unlocked, and follows the island's position and size settings.

- The YouTube client and its Music player entry are removed again.
- Athenaeum: it follows Pulse's looks (Windows 95 to 11, Material, AMOLED black) from its own settings, the menus and settings are in Turkish too (the card and entry texts stay English), and the support and author lines are gone.
